question: Four letter-pair triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LM - IJ - GH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29143535db6209bf961767090b50ed192ce0579adfa7f1156a747f3c6abb28da.png] 

Option 2) CD - ZA - XY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfdbbb1f005316ae33cc8bd020d667c422d3384113c9f7ec35eb656b1a1558d5.png] 

Option 3) ST - UV - XY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08022a1aa8c2d703b9f4ad5bb6b93faf79b37d9af42ca5b70cc5d2c28cb82e04.png] 

Option 4) AB - XY - VW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/589c289494de03cf5fe620338221f7ec085397de3ddf94c9125ddf2f639c116c.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'ST - UV - XY' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
